title: Farmland Flowers
description: Makes small flowers spread when planted on farmland.
body:
Small mod that makes naturally generating small flowers spread to adjacent farmland blocks. You may change which blocks are affected using the `#farmlandflowers:spreads_on_farmland` tag.

**CONFIGURATION**

`"defaultSuccessRate"`: The chance of blocks spreading whenever farmland gets ticked in clear weather.

`"rainSuccessRate"`: The chance of blocks spreading whenever farmland gets ticked under rain. Is same as "defaultSuccessRate" by default, increase this to boost the chance of succesful spread attempts.

`"rainBonusAttempts"`: Extra spread attempts whenever it's raining. Higher number means higher chance to place multiple blocks every time a spread is attempted.
